title: Reading PHP error logs like bloodwork: a triage field guide
lede: A 16:47 Friday message: site is throwing 500s, sometimes. You SSH in, tail the log, see eight hundred lines of red. This is how to triage them in order.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of a PHP error log with red triage marks, graph-paper checklist, manila tab, brass plate, wax seal on linen.
